title: Top 10 Best C-Dramas to Watch in 2026
excerpt: From historical romances and fantasy epics to modern love stories, these 10 Chinese dramas have attracted passionate audiences in China and around the world, becoming some of the most recognizable titles in the C-drama landscape.
body:
Chinese dramas have become a major part of the global Asian entertainment landscape.

Over the past several years, C-dramas have reached audiences far beyond mainland China, with international viewers discovering everything from large-scale historical productions to modern romances, fantasy adventures and youth dramas.

With hundreds of series released across different genres, choosing only ten is almost impossible. So rather than treating this as an official ranking, **Bullet News Global has selected 10 widely recognized C-dramas that have made a particularly strong impression on international audiences.**

Here are the titles that stand out.

## 10. Love O2O (2016)

**Genre:** Romance • Youth • Technology

*Love O2O* combines university life, friendship, romance and online gaming.

The series follows Bei Weiwei, a university student and computer science major, whose online gaming life eventually connects with Xiao Nai, one of the most talented students on campus.

The drama became particularly popular among viewers looking for a lighthearted romance with a technology and gaming element.

Its combination of campus life, online gaming and romance helped it attract viewers outside China as well.

**Why watch it:**
A relatively easy entry point for viewers who enjoy modern romance and university stories.

**Where to watch:** Check official availability on Youku / Viki / iQIYI / Youtube / Netflix, depending on your region.

## 9. Go Ahead

**Genre:** Family • Youth • Romance • Drama

*Go Ahead* takes a different approach from the typical romance-focused C-drama.

The story centers around three young people who form an unconventional family after growing up together despite coming from very different backgrounds.

The series explores childhood, family relationships, growing up and the complicated process of becoming an adult.

Its emotional storytelling helped it connect with viewers who wanted something deeper than a traditional romance.

**Why watch it:**
A character-driven story about family, friendship and growing up.

**Where to watch:** Check official availability on Youku / Viki / iQIYI / Youtube / Netflix, depending on your region.

## 8. The Long Ballad

**Genre:** Historical • Romance • Action

Set against a historical backdrop, *The Long Ballad* follows Li Changge, a young woman whose life changes dramatically after a devastating political event.

Her journey takes her across a turbulent landscape filled with political conflicts, battles and complicated relationships.

The series combines historical drama with action and romance, giving international viewers a taste of the large-scale storytelling that has become one of the defining features of Chinese historical television.

**Why watch it:**
For viewers who enjoy historical settings, political intrigue and action.

**Where to watch:** Check official availability on Youku / Viki / iQIYI / Youtube / Netflix, depending on your region.

## 7. Love Between Fairy and Devil

**Genre:** Fantasy • Romance • Xianxia

Few modern fantasy C-dramas have attracted as much international attention as *Love Between Fairy and Devil*.

The story follows a seemingly unlikely relationship between a powerful figure and a young fairy whose personalities and circumstances could hardly be more different.

The series combines fantasy mythology, romance, elaborate costumes and large-scale visual production.

Its distinctive fantasy world helped introduce many international viewers to the **xianxia** genre.

**Why watch it:**
A visually ambitious fantasy romance with a strong central relationship.

**Where to watch:** Check official availability on Youku / Viki / iQIYI / Youtube / Netflix, depending on your region.

## 6. Till the End of the Moon

**Genre:** Fantasy • Romance • Xianxia

*Till the End of the Moon* explores the complicated relationship between destiny, power and love.

The series follows characters caught in a conflict involving demonic power and the fate of the world.

Its dark fantasy atmosphere, elaborate costumes and complex story made it particularly appealing to viewers who prefer more intense fantasy dramas.

**Why watch it:**
For audiences looking for a darker and more dramatic fantasy experience.

**Where to watch:** Check official availability on Youku / Viki / iQIYI / Youtube / Netflix, depending on your region.

## 5. The Untamed (2019)

**Genre:** Fantasy • Historical • Mystery • Wuxia

*The Untamed* became one of the most internationally recognizable Chinese dramas of its generation.

Set in a world of cultivation, clans and supernatural mysteries, the story follows Wei Wuxian and Lan Wangji as they uncover secrets connected to their past.

The drama developed a large international fanbase, with viewers drawn to its characters, world-building, music and mystery-driven storyline.

Its popularity also helped introduce many international viewers to Chinese **wuxia** and cultivation-inspired storytelling.

**Why watch it:**
Strong characters, mystery, mythology and an expansive fantasy world.

**Where to watch:** Check official availability on Youku / Viki / iQIYI / Youtube / Netflix, depending on your region.

## 4. Nirvana in Fire

**Genre:** Historical • Political • Strategy • Drama

For viewers who prefer strategy and political storytelling, *Nirvana in Fire* is one of the standout titles.

The series follows a brilliant strategist who returns under a new identity and becomes involved in a complex struggle surrounding the imperial court.

Rather than relying primarily on romance, the drama builds its story around political maneuvering, loyalty, revenge and carefully planned strategies.

It has earned a particularly strong reputation among viewers who appreciate sophisticated historical storytelling.

**Why watch it:**
A smart political drama built around strategy, loyalty and intrigue.

**Where to watch:** Check official availability on Youku / Viki / iQIYI / Youtube / Netflix, depending on your region.

## 3. Story of Yanxi Palace

**Genre:** Historical • Palace • Drama

*Story of Yanxi Palace* became a major success and attracted considerable attention outside China.

The series follows Wei Yingluo, a determined young woman who enters the imperial palace and gradually becomes involved in the complicated world of court politics.

Its elaborate costumes, palace setting and strategic character interactions became major attractions for viewers.

The drama also became particularly recognizable internationally through streaming platforms and online fan communities.

**Why watch it:**
Palace intrigue, strong characters and an elaborate historical setting.

**Where to watch:** Check official availability on Youku / Viki / iQIYI / Youtube/ Netflix, depending on your region.

## 2. Hidden Love (2023)

**Genre:** Romance • Youth • Coming-of-Age

*Hidden Love* became one of the most talked-about modern C-dramas among international viewers.

The story follows Sang Zhi as she grows from a young student into adulthood and develops a relationship with Duan Jiaxu.

The drama focuses heavily on everyday moments, family relationships, friendship and the gradual development of its central romance.

Its popularity demonstrated how modern Chinese romance dramas can reach audiences far beyond China's domestic market.

**Why watch it:**
A warm, character-focused coming-of-age romance.

**Where to watch:** Check official availability on Youku / Viki / iQIYI / Youtube /Netflix, depending on your region.

# 1. Fangs of Fortune

**Genre:** Fantasy • Wuxia • Romance • Historical

*Fangs of Fortune* is a visually ambitious Chinese fantasy drama that blends mythology, adventure, romance and martial-arts storytelling.

Set in a world filled with supernatural mysteries, the series follows characters whose paths become connected through a dangerous journey involving powerful forces and hidden secrets.

The drama stands out for its atmospheric visual style, elaborate costumes and fantasy-driven story. Its combination of action, mythology and character relationships has also attracted international attention from viewers exploring modern Chinese fantasy dramas.

Rather than focusing only on romance, *Fangs of Fortune* builds a larger world around its characters, giving viewers a mixture of adventure, mystery and emotional storytelling.

**Why watch it:**
A strong choice for viewers who enjoy **Chinese fantasy, wuxia-style adventures, supernatural mysteries and visually rich storytelling.**

**Where to watch:** Check official availability on Youku / Viki / iQIYI / Youtube /Netflix, depending on your region.

The C-drama landscape is far too large to fit into a single top-ten list.

# Why C-Dramas Are Reaching More International Viewers

The growing international interest in Chinese dramas reflects a wider change in Asian entertainment.

Streaming platforms have made Chinese-language productions much easier for international audiences to discover. Subtitles and international releases have also reduced some of the barriers that previously limited viewers to productions from their own countries.

At the same time, C-dramas offer something for almost every type of viewer.

Want romance?

There's modern romance.

Want fantasy?

There's xianxia.

Want martial arts?

There's wuxia.

Want palace politics?

Historical dramas have plenty.

Want something contemporary?

Modern Chinese series cover university life, careers, family, technology and everyday relationships.

# The Global C-Drama Audience

Perhaps the biggest change is that international viewers are no longer simply discovering individual Chinese dramas.

They're discovering **the wider C-drama ecosystem**.

A viewer might begin with a modern romance, move into historical dramas, discover xianxia and wuxia, and eventually start exploring Chinese actors, directors, music and literature.

That creates an increasingly connected international audience around Chinese entertainment.

# Bullet News Global's Take

The rise of C-dramas internationally is more than a trend in streaming.

It shows how stories can cross borders when audiences find characters, worlds and themes they connect with.

There is no single formula for a successful C-drama. Some rely on romance, others on fantasy, history, comedy or political intrigue.

But the strongest productions share one thing:

**They give audiences a world they want to keep exploring.**

And as international access to Chinese entertainment continues to expand, the global C-drama audience could become even larger.
